search.website_text:
A dalamud plugin for computing the most effective use of current or configured resources ### WachuMakeyMaking?

# Can't decide what to make with what you've got?

"/wymm" will open a window with 3 tabs:

- Resources
    - Loads the content of your inventory into a table
    - Allows altering the quantity of (or to entirely turn off) resources that the solver is allowed to consider
    - Can reset back to inventory state at any time
    - Click "Submit" at any time to pass your selection to the Recipes tab
- Recipes
    - Computes which recipes can be made with the selected resources
    - Fetches prices from Universalis for your homeworld for each recipe
    - Allows setting the conversion rate of scrips into gil to allow automated pricing of collectables
    - Allows altering the price of (or to entirely turn off) recipes that the solver will use
    - Can reset back to initial computed prices and selection
    - Click "Solve" at any time to pass your selection to the solver and move to the Results tab
- Results
    - Displays progress of the solver
    - When finished, will display the optimal integer solution found in a table

variant.changelog:
- Added the option to add all the resources needed to craft an item in one go (only direct ingredients, not recursive)
 - Added resource addition filters that let you filter the dropdowns by the type of recipes they appear in. Each box ticked will add more options.
   - e.g. selecting "11-15", "51-55", and "Tabletop" will combine all things that can be crafted from those 3 groups and find the ingredients referenced by all of them.
   - The 4 "Other" divisions that start with "Only" are mutually exclusive pairs that restrict, rather than add, from the combined list you selected above.

variant.author: Nesrie
variant.changelog:
The not-at-all awaited V2.0 is here! :D
 - Huge "engine" refactor to get rid of all the spaghetti and improve performance
 - Fixed a lot of bugs around properly reflecting inventory changes when they're added/removed/change inventory
 - Recipes now reflect what you can make via intermediate steps, e.g. if you don't have iron ingots but you do have ore you can still make it
 - Results now show how many of what you're needing to use to make them on click
 - Results recipe open is now shift + click and won't close the recipe if it's already open
 - A lot more I've probably forgotten by now
